entries.summary: Host adapters can compute the instruction frozen by K8 sync with botTurnInstruction on the host-kit entry, using an options object and InstructionLimits.

macOS Keychain and Linux Secret Service report an SDK entry that does not decode as the new KEYCHAIN_SECRET_CORRUPTED instead of KEYCHAIN_SECRET_DECODE_FAILED, and ProviderRegistry.replaceSecret/configure overwrite it with a new key. KEYCHAIN_SECRET_DECODE_FAILED now means an entry the SDK did not write; the registry never overwrites it and refuses before any write. A Host that offered 'enter the key again' for KEYCHAIN_SECRET_DECODE_FAILED offers it for KEYCHAIN_SECRET_CORRUPTED and shows delete, rename or other-profile guidance for KEYCHAIN_SECRET_DECODE_FAILED. ProviderRegistry.configure/replaceSecret/setDefaultModelProvider/delete reject with the new PROVIDER_CHANGE_COMMITTED when the change committed but a later step (the auth-none key delete or the lock release) failed; treat it as success and read the status again.
